articles.summary: CHICAGO, Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Rush Street Interactive, Inc. (NYSE: RSI) (“RSI”) today announced that it will release its third quarter 2026 results after the market close on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, followed by a conference call at 6:00 pm Eastern Time (5:00 pm Central Time) to discuss the results. RSI’s earnings press release and related materials will be available at ir.rushstreetinteractive.com . To listen to the audio webcast and live QA, please visit RSI’s investor relations website at ir.rushstreetinteractive.com . Interested parties may also dial 1-833-461-5787 (Toll Free) or 1-585-542-9983 (Local) or, for international callers, please reference https://help.events.q4inc.com/eahc/international-dial-in-numbers . The conference call access code is 667719786. An audio replay of the webcast will be available on RSI’s investor relations website shortly after the call until at least November 30, 2026. About RSI RSI is a trusted online gaming and sports
articles.title: Rush Street Interactive Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date
